segments.name: Contract Manufacturing
segments.description: Provides engineering design and manufacturing services for complex electromedical and electromechanical products to OEMs in medical, aerospace, defense and industrial markets.
segments.evidence: Substantially all of our operations fall under the Contract Manufacturing segment within the Electronic Manufacturing Services ("EMS") industry.

revenueModel.text: OEM customers pay the company for contract manufacturing of products built to their unique design specifications, plus engineering, testing and supply chain services.
revenueModel.evidence: Most of our net sales are derived from products built to the customer's unique design specifications.
